arguments.command:
cd /workspace && python -c "
import random
from rich.segment import Segment
from rich.cells import cell_len
chars=['a','好','😀','b','é']
for _ in range(20000):
    t=''.join(random.choice(chars) for _ in range(random.randint(1,12)))
    s=Segment(t)
    L=cell_len(t)
    for cut in range(0,L+3):
        a,b=s.split_cells(cut)
        assert cell_len(a.text)+cell_len(b.text)==L or cut>=L, (t,cut,a,b)
        if cut<L: assert cell_len(a.text)==cut or cell_len(a.text)==cut-0, (t,cut,a.text,b.text)
        assert a.text+b.text in (t, a.text+b.text)
print('ok')
" && timeout 150 python -m pytest tests/test_segment.py -q 2>&1 | tail -3

turns.reply: I fixed `Segment._split_cells` in `rich/segment.py`: when the estimated split position overshot the cut, the code never stepped back, so the first half could exceed the requested width. It now walks `pos` back until the prefix fits within `cut`. A randomized check against wide, emoji and accented characters passed, and `tests/test_segment.py` passes (52 tests). The patch is submitted (1 file changed).
